newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks edge higher in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks edge higher in London trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks nudged higher in London trading on Friday, boosted by renewed strength in property stocks and led by gains in HSBC Holdings, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 27.11 points, or 0.2 percent, at 13,143.90, after the Hang Seng in Hong Kong earlier closed 0.1 percent higher at a near-record 13,116.79.
HSBC was quoted up HK$1.25 from its Hong Kong close at HK$156.75 while among real estate stocks Swire Pacific was up 25 HK cents at HK$75.50.
"We have seen continued strength from recent signs of strength in investment property and I think it will continue," said one trader at a leading investment bank here.
Chinese Estates Holdings said on Friday it had agreed to sell its Entertainment Building in Hong Kong's central district for HK$3.64 billion, regarded as a rich price.
